searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/953 any client devs have a sense of the possibility of verifying header integrity upon getting a mev-boost bid but before constructing + signing the blinded block? seems like CLs could do a somewhat lightweight check before signing the mev-boost header and that would have avoided the bloxroute situation entirely
